summary: The marketing team is prioritizing the China Going-Global report, Asia Start, and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving urgent email access issues.
summaryDetail: The most critical immediate issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting team email access; all members must delete and re-add accounts, update passwords, and confirm backend unlocks today. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has approved the current layout with menu categorization, decided to integrate BCI/BSI indices, and will disperse videos by topic; Joseph must share the HTML concept and hold a feedback session this week to finalize design changes. Marketing efforts are focused on prioritizing Asia Start and Intelligent China for SEO and analytics, with Joseph drafting target areas and the team auditing conversion tracking. Upcoming priorities include reviewing invitation letters for Prof. Tao and panelists, scheduling a call with Stuart on BritCham membership, and addressing design feedback for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum.
